Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Take for yourself from yourself; take from it during health before sickness, and during strength before weakness, and during life before death.
ai.seo_question: What does the Imam mean by taking from yourself while you are healthy?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises believers to utilize their periods of health, strength, and life to perform good deeds before they are overtaken by sickness, weakness, and death. This is an exhortation to proactive worship and self-improvement, emphasizing the concept of *al-istidraaj* (gradual preparation) where one must seize the opportunity of *al-afah* (health/strength) while it is still present. In Shia scholarly tradition, this hadith underscores the urgency of *amal* (action) during times of ease, as the transition to the next state is often sudden and beyond human control.
